about.description: Industrial-metals perpetual on Gains Network priced off the Global X Uranium ETF (URA), a uranium-mining-equity ETF, with pricing referencing Chainlink DON. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC / DAI / WETH on Arbitrum / Polygon / Base. Users get sector exposure without holding ETF shares or constituent equities.
